meta.name: stitch-design-taste
meta.description: Semantic Design System Skill for Google Stitch. Generates agent-friendly DESIGN.md files that enforce premium, anti-generic UI standards — strict typography, calibrated color, asymmetric layouts, perpetual micro-motion, and hardware-accelerated performance.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 为项目生成符合高级设计标准的 DESIGN.md 文件
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你需要为项目建立严格、高质量的设计规范文档
copy.tagline_en: Generate DESIGN.md files enforcing premium UI standards for your project
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to establish strict, high-quality design guidelines for your project

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会生成一份 DESIGN.md 文件，用来指导 Google Stitch 生成界面。文件包含颜色、字体、布局、动效等设计规则，并明确禁止常见 AI 设计套路（如紫色霓虹、Inter 字体、纯黑背景等）。
howto.when: 当用户要求为 Google Stitch 项目生成设计规范，或描述界面风格（如“画廊风”“高密度仪表盘”）时触发。

say.text: 为我的数据仪表盘生成一份 Stitch 设计规范。
我想要一个不对称、高动感的画廊风格界面。
say.note: Claude 会根据描述调整密度、方差和动效参数。

howto.what_en: When installed, Claude generates a DESIGN.md file for Google Stitch screen generation. It encodes color, typography, layout, motion rules, and banned AI design clichés (e.g., no purple neon, no Inter font, no pure black).
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user asks to generate a design system for Google Stitch, or describes a visual style (e.g., 'gallery airy', 'high-density dashboard').

say_en.text: Generate a Stitch design spec for my data dashboard.
say_en.note: Claude outputs a DESIGN.md with color, fonts, layout rules.

say_en.text: I want an asymmetric, high-motion gallery-style interface.
say_en.note: Claude adjusts density, variance, and motion parameters accordingly.
